source: Fundations Level 1 Scope and Sequence, Teacher's Manual preface pp.37-39

units.title: Letters and sounds
skills: letter-keyword-sound for consonants and short vowels

units.title: Short vowel words
skills: blend, read and spell 3-sound short-vowel words

sentences.text: The pig is in the pit.
Max and Dad sit in the hut.
A red hen is in the pen.
The cat is on a mat.
Dad hid the cup in the box.

units.title: Digraphs and question mark
skills: digraphs wh ch sh th and ck (ck at the end)

sounds_new.say: /th/ as in thin, or /th/ as in this

sentences.text: Is the chick on the rock?
Is this a rock or a log?
Is the pig in the shed?
Did the mob run to the shack?

units.title: Bonus letters and ALL
skills: bonus letters ff ll ss zz

sentences.text: Your doll is on the hill.
The big pig fell off the hill!
The mob was on the hill.
The man ran from the mob!
Does the pig have a fan?
The dogs ran to the hills.
There are bugs on the rocks.
The ships were on the hill.

units.title: Glued sounds ang ing ong ung ank ink onk unk
skills: glued sounds ang ing ong ung ank ink onk unk

sentences.text: The king has a long song.
I think the tank is too long.
The bat hung on the bank.
Put the ring in the bank.

units.title: Blends
skills: consonant blends and digraph blends up to 4 sounds
r-controlled vowel sounds ar or er ir ur (named as sounds only; words with them are not read yet)

sentences.text: The frog can jump over the log.
Her dog is in the sand.
I could swim past the crab.
Should we stop at the spot?
The best crab is in the tank!
I got a number on my hand.
Her milk is on the desk.

units.title: Closed syllables
skills: vowel team sounds ai ay ee ea ey oi oy (named as sounds only; words with them are not read yet)

sounds_new.say: /ē/ as in eat, or /ĕ/ as in head
/ā/ as in they, or /ē/ as in key

sentences.text: The frog sat on a big flag.
Dad can stand on the black deck.
Tim can swim past the crab.
Is the glass on the desk?
Dad will pick a lot of cash.
Each mob must stop at the tent.
See the crab snap the twig.
Is the plum between the cups?

units.title: Five sounds, -ed and -ing
skills: vowel team sounds oa oe ow ou oo ue ew au aw (named as sounds only; words with them are not read yet)

sounds_new.say: /ō/ as in snow, or /ow/ as in cow
/oo/ as in moon, or /oo/ as in book
/ū/ as in cue, or /oo/ as in blue
/ū/ as in few, or /oo/ as in grew

sentences.text: Now the mob is out of the tent.
The frog is jumping in the sand.
Any mob can stand on the stump.

sounds_new.say: long u, as in cute, or /oo/ as in rule

sentences.text: I like to ride my bike.
Some bones are in the cave.
Take the rope and dive in!
Another mole is in the hole.

units.title: Syllables and compound words
skills: syllable division: two closed syllables or closed plus silent e

sentences.text: A little rabbit sat in the basket.
We visit Dad in a month.
Mr. Max has been to a campfire.
The sunset is on the hill.
Mrs. Hill sat on the bench.
Look at the insects in the boxes.
The new products were in the baskets.
Their rabbits sit in the boxes.
The first people visited the cave.
The mob stands on the hill and blinks.
Dad got water in the cave.
The mob may stop at the gate.
Drive the van to the lake.
She expects the crab to snap.
